articles.title: Price tag for US war in Iran barrels past $48 billion
articles.summary: A Pentagon budget officer has said the price of the Iran war surpassed $48.3 billion last week. That does not include costs sustained in Iranian attacks on US bases — lawmakers want details the Pentagon is loath to give.

articles.title: Ukraine: Russian strikes damage Austrian and Dutch embassies in Kyiv
articles.summary: Russian strikes damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies in Kyiv on Thursday. Windows were shattered and vehicles damaged, but diplomatic staff escaped unharmed.

articles.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
articles.summary: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.
